result.description: A fictional high-capacity internal solid state drive designed for quiet desktop archivists and media vault builds. The Lattice 240 uses a PCIe 5.0 x4 interface, an M.2 2280 form factor, and TLC flash to balance endurance with fast everyday transfers. It emphasizes large sequential throughput, low idle power, and broad compatibility with modern Windows and Linux systems. This model is positioned as a storage-focused consumer SSD rather than a graphics card or USB flash drive.
result.title: NOVA Lattice 240 2 TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe
